author: Learn Linux TV
description:
*Check out my Troubleshooting eBook* ➜ https://learnlinux.link/troubleshooting-ebook

ISO files have been the standard way to download and install Linux distributions for decades—but is it time for Linux to move on? In this video, I make the case that Linux ISO files should be replaced by IMG disk images, especially now that most people install Linux using bootable USB drives rather than CDs or DVDs.
